thread:
lina: Heads up — 10% staged rollout of v2024.11 is live in us-east / eu-west. Noticing a small uptick in parsing errors for long prompts in eu-west (p95 latency + 60ms, parse-error-rate 0.9% up from 0.1%). Can we do a quick stop/go?

deploy-bot: deploy 1784001122 initiated by lina — canary -> 10% traffic. Instances: 8/80 healthy. Logs: `svc:ingress` streaming. :rocket:

chris: I can look at the error traces. quick ask — are we using the new tokenizer patch or the fallback tokenizer?

maya: This rollout included the tokenizer patch. I suggested shipping w/ fallback enabled, but the build had fallback off due to a packaging mismatch.

sam: Release notes need a tiny fix (tokenizer behavior change). Should we pause to push the note and pin the canary to previous model variant until patch is safe?

release-manager: Change window still open til 18:00 UTC. If ops wants to hold, we can pin and open an incident timeline. What's the team vote?

ops-runner: Suggest hold at 10% until we confirm parsing failures are repeatable on canary. Quick mitigation: enable tokenizer fallback on canary nodes (config toggle) then re-observe for 15m. If errors persist, roll to 0% and rollback to v2024.10.

chris: Repro steps — ran 50 long-prompt samples against canary host (10.2.3.45) and saw 6/50 parse errors. Attaching snippet: ```
ERROR parse::unexpected_end at input pos 1024
stack: tokenizer::segfault? -> recovered via fallback path
```

lina: OK ops-runner plan sounds good. Can we flip fallback remotely? That should be a low-risk config flip. Who toggles?

maya: I can push the toggle to canary pool now. Will confirm rollout of the toggle.

deploy-bot: running command: `redwoodctl config set tokenizer.fallback=true --selector rollout=canary`
deploy-bot: 8 targets matched. starting config rollout...

deploy-bot: config rollout complete on 8/8 targets. status=success.

ops-runner: Watching metrics. p95 latency back to baseline in us-east, in eu-west p95 improved ~25ms. parse-error-rate dropped to 0.15% (observed over 10m). Recommend holding for one bake window (20m) before continuing to 25%.

sam: I've updated the release notes with a note about tokenizer fallback behavior and a troubleshooting step. Pushed to the release branch: `release/v2024.11-notes`

release-manager: Vote check — lina? chris? maya? sam? ops-runner? Mark with :thumbsup: to proceed or :thumbsdown: to keep hold.

lina: :thumbsup: (hold until 20m bake then proceed to 25% if stable)

chris: :thumbsup: (after fallback confirmation)

maya: :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup: (release notes good)

ops-runner: :thumbsup:

release-manager: Consensus -> proceed after bake. I'll annotate rollout ticket and unpin the emergency hold. Next step: ramp to 25% at ~1784002320 unless any regressions.

deploy-bot: annotate rollout 1784001122: "fallback-enabled, bake window started by ops-runner"

lina: Thanks all. Will monitor. If anything spikes, we revert to v2024.10 and run postmortem.

deploy-bot: scheduled ramp to 25% at 1784002320 (ETA ~16m).
